abstract: Evaluates commercial warranties, service-level compensation schedules, and vendor performance history
system_message:
You are the Commercial maintenance contract manager (COM), responsible for evaluating commercial warranties, service-level compensation schedules, and vendor performance history across prospective maintenance facilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Volume rebate policy（DISC）
information_points.content:
COM-DISC-XPC：According to the commercial master services agreement, Getafe Airframe Overhaul Complex offers a baseline volume rebate rate of 3 % on non-destructive testing work under annual fleet check commitments.
COM-DISC-73M：Pursuant to the commercial master services agreement based on annual fleet check commitments, Shannon Aerospace Maintenance Centre applies a baseline volume rebate rate of 5 % to non-destructive testing work.
COM-DISC-01K：Under its commercial master services agreement for annual fleet check volume commitments, Dresden Aviation Engineering Base maintains a baseline volume rebate rate of 8 % for non-destructive testing services.

information_points.title: Evaluates commercial warranties, service-level compensation schedules, and vendor performance history（COMM）
information_points.content:
COM-COMM-BZE：Under standard airframe maintenance contract terms covering defects attributable to workmanship following check release, Shannon Aerospace Maintenance Centre provides a post-overhaul workmanship warranty period of 12 mo.
COM-COMM-GJW：Getafe Airframe Overhaul Complex offers a post-overhaul workmanship warranty period of 18 mo for all workmanship defects identified following check release.
COM-COMM-U11：For Dresden Aviation Engineering Base, standard contract terms specify a post-overhaul workmanship warranty period of 24 mo covering defect repairs attributable to workmanship after release.
